# One case of place_job, on Maya's rooftop-garden app.
case	A Windows job with Maya's machines off skips Tenki, which has no Windows machines
places	order=own,tenki,github wait=10 connected=tenki usual=6
job	windows	pr	self-hosted,windows,pr
keep	on
queued	0
gone	no
now	1793000000
runner	offline	false	self-hosted,windows,pr
expect	github	windows-latest	no	offline	own:offline,tenki:system
words	Your machine was offline, so this ran on GitHub.
